description: Planning dispatch (T3, D9): `brief-agreed` items send their brief to the SAME project-planner body S13 shipped, through the SAME ordinary step door S24's sizing rode — nothing custom, no second planner. The answer names the host loop the step rides (its deterministic slug is the double-dispatch guard: the machine has no `planning` rung to wear a claim, so the loop's own key does). The item lands `planned` only when the handoff's task_count is a real count AND plan.md is on disk; a failed run leaves `brief-agreed` and nothing retries silently (T3).
